item.title: New recipe: Petrol Prices UK
item.description: Created by community member laviathan. Enable and decide to bike instead.
item.content:encoded:
Petrol Prices UK : Lowest reported fuel prices nearby

By laviathan · travel, finance

Created by community member laviathan. Enable and decide to bike instead.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

See the lowest reported pump prices near you, from the UK government's official <a href="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/access-the-latest-fuel-prices-and-forecourt-data-via-api-or-email" class="underline">Fuel Finder</a> service. Enter a UK postcode, a search radius and a fuel grade: the screen ranks the three lowest reported prices within that straight-line radius, shows ties honestly, and adds the nearest reporting forecourt for context, together with the time the prices were last synced.<br/><br/> Prices are the pump prices forecourts report before any discounts or loyalty offers. Distances are straight-line, not driving distances. The plugin does not show whether a forecourt is open or has fuel in stock, and it does not estimate savings. Forecourts that do not report to Fuel Finder are not shown, and a forecourt whose reported location is more than 5 miles from its own postcode is placed at its postcode. If prices have not been updated for more than 30 minutes the screen says so instead of showing a leaderboard.<br/><br/> Spotted a wrong price? <a href="https://www.fuel-finder.service.gov.uk/motorist/price-report" class="underline">Report a discrepancy to Fuel Finder</a>.<br/><br/> Contains public sector information licensed under the <a href="https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/" class="underline">Open Government Licence v3.0</a>. Postcode lookup by <a href="https://postcodes.io" class="underline">postcodes.io</a>: contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right; Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right; National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right. Your postcode is sent to the Petrol Prices UK service and postcodes.io only to find its coordinates; it is not logged or linked to your account.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

Gridiron Power Rankings puts the whole NFL power picture on your TRMNL. Pick your team and it is highlighted on every layout, or give it the full screen: a poster with its power rank, record, division place, games back and next game, with the kickoff in your time zone. item.title: New recipe: Himekuri
item.description: Created by community member ewijaya. Enable and avoid the papercuts.
item.content:encoded:
Himekuri : Showa tear-off calendar 昭和の日めくり

By ewijaya · calendar, life

Created by community member ewijaya. Enable and avoid the papercuts.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

A Shōwa-era Japanese tear-off calendar (日めくり), one page a day, entirely in Japanese and in crisp black and white.<br/>
Each page shows the day in a big serif numeral, the lunar date (旧暦), rokuyō (六曜), nine stars (九星), the day's zodiac pair (干支), lunar mansion (二十八宿), lucky and unlucky days (選日), the moon and tide name, the solar term and its micro-season (二十四節気・七十二候), festivals and observances, a countdown to the next holiday, a month calendar, and a proverb (ことわざ) written vertically. Sundays and holidays print in reverse, Saturdays in outline.<br/>
昭和の日めくりカレンダー。旧暦・六曜・九星・干支・二十八宿・選日・月と潮・二十四節気と七十二候・行事と記念日・次の祝日まで・月のこよみ・今日のことわざを一枚に。日曜と祝日は白抜き、土曜は袋文字。<br/>
Optional: large print, Japanese era or Western year, and a shop band at the foot, like the gift calendars local shops handed out (「毎度ありがとうございます　さくら商店」).<br/>
The calendar is computed from JPL ephemerides and checked against published almanacs; proverbs are traditional, observances are facts. Works on every TRMNL screen, landscape or portrait.

Obsidian Screens : Your Obsidian vault on TRMNL

By Barry Michael Doyle · productivity, personal

Created by community member barrymichaeldoyle. Enable and sharpen your thinking.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

An independent recipe for Obsidian. The free TRMNL Screens plugin for Obsidian reads your vault on your own device and pushes one screen of it to this recipe's webhook URL, only when that screen changes. Nothing else is sent. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian.<br><br>Obsidian Screens puts your notes on your TRMNL: today's daily note tasks grouped by heading, due and overdue tasks from anywhere in your vault, the rows of a Dataview query, an older note resurfaced each day, your writing streak with words written today, or a pinned note such as a weekly plan. Due dates from the Tasks plugin and Dataview are both understood, and links read as plain text.<br><br>Install this recipe once for each screen you want. Then install TRMNL Screens from Obsidian's Community plugins, paste this recipe's webhook URL into a screen in its settings, and select Push now. The plugin keeps the screen current by itself, a minute after you stop editing. Full-screen and all three mashup layouts are included, on TRMNL OG and TRMNL X.

item.content:encoded:
Atmosphere : Xiaomi Weather forecasts

By Creator #28055 · environment

From the author (About This Plugin)

Atmosphere, formerly Xiaomi Weather, brings current conditions and weather forecasts to your TRMNL using the same endpoint as Xiaomi phones. Choose a city, address, postal code or coordinates with the searchable Location picker, then select Celsius or Fahrenheit. See the current temperature, feels-like temperature, hourly trend and daily outlook, plus precipitation chances, wind, humidity, sunrise, sunset and UV when the provider supplies them. All four layouts support TRMNL OG and TRMNL X, including portrait. Observations older than three hours are marked, missing values remain visible as unavailable, and alerts are reported as supplied by the provider. No personal weather API key or separate server is required. Created by Ivan Perez; use the GitHub link for support and setup instructions.

WedgieTracker counts every time an NBA basketball gets stuck between the rim and the backboard.
